ci: two-sided percentile bootstrap, 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles, numpy method=linear
sampling: ordinary non-stratified bootstrap of G units with replacement, G draws per replicate; every image in a sampled cluster has its cluster multiplicity; image-weighted metrics

units.MESSIDOR-2: official ADCIS left/right table row; examination pair, not inferred biological patient

QWK: five fixed labels 0..4, quadratic weights, original stored grade prediction; do not use referral decision as grade prediction
AUROC: grade>=2 versus grade<=1, original finite float64 referral log-odds score, exact ties receive one half
nonestimable: undefined original metric => NE; zero QWK expected-disagreement denominator, one-class AUROC, or zero conditional rate denominator => NaN for that metric in that replicate; paired delta valid only when both operands finite; never redraw; CI NE if fewer than 9900/10000 finite replicates; report counts and reason
multiplicity: marginal descriptive 95% intervals; no multiplicity adjustment, p-values, or claim of family-wise significance
thresholds: Fixed CAL thresholds; referral if score >= threshold.
pairing: The same resampled units are used for both members of every paired comparison.
